# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster is healed of d10 concussion hits.
@@ 2
Will heal one area of mild frostbite or a 1st degree burn.
@@ 3
Caster is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
@@ 4
Reduces damage by 1 hit every round as long as caster concentrates. If caster
is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.
@@ 5
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except 2 areas of mild damage or 1 area of moderate
damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn) are healed.
@@ 6
Caster is instantly awake from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell,
sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.
@@ 7
As Heal I, except caster can heal 5d10 concussion hits.
@@ 8
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe
damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or a combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area
can be healed.
@@ 9
As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 3 rounds accumulated stun
effects.
@@ 10
As Regenerate I, except 2 hits are healed every round.
@@ 11
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except the area(s) of damage that can be healed are: 5
mild and 1 severe or 1 mild and 2 moderate or 1 moderate and 1 severe or etc.
@@ 12
As Heal I, except caster can heal 10d10 concussion hits.
@@ 13
As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 5 rounds accumulated stun
effects.
@@ 15
As Regenerate I, except 3 hits are healed every round.
@@ 17
As Heal I, except caster can heal 15d10 concussion hits.
@@ 19
As Stun Relief I, except caster is relieved of 10 rounds accumulated stun
effects.
@@ 20
As Heal I, except caster can heal 20d10 concussion hits.
@@ 25
As Heal I, except caster is healed of all concussion hits.
@@ 30
Caster is relieved of all burns and/or frostbite.
@@ 50
Caster is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.
